cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-layout-never-changes-source-characters
cases.purpose: Layout changes display properties, never the logical character stream.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-overlong-no-break-preserves-atom
cases.purpose: A rigid overflow atom remains intact in the public projection.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-projection-fires-no-external-change-hooks
cases.purpose: Projection installation and removal are silent to external change hooks.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-ascii-glue-combines-space-and-min-width
cases.purpose: Existing ASCII spaces use `space-width' plus an exact `min-width' floor.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-cjk-zero-source-glue-uses-min-width
cases.purpose: CJK glue pads an existing grapheme and inserts no source space.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-hyphen-and-break-are-display-only
cases.purpose: A discretionary hyphen and newline live in `display', not source text.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-indentation-uses-line-prefix
cases.purpose: First-line indentation is a `line-prefix' projection.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-roundtrip-exact
cases.purpose: justify + unjustify restores text and properties exactly.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-roundtrip-propertized
cases.purpose: Roundtrip preserves user text properties.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-hard-newlines-preserved
cases.purpose: Hard newline count survives justification.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-justified-marked
cases.purpose: Justified region carries the ekp-justified width property.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-rejustify-idempotent
cases.purpose: Justifying at a new width equals a fresh justification at that width.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-edit-then-unjustify
cases.purpose: Text typed into a justified buffer survives unjustification.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-point-stable
cases.purpose: Point returns to its logical position after a roundtrip.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-inactive-mark-stays-inactive
cases.purpose: Reprojection preserves an existing inactive mark without selecting text.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-active-region-stays-active
cases.purpose: Reprojection preserves an intentional active region.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-verbatim-paragraph-skipped
cases.purpose: A code-block paragraph stays byte-identical; prose around it justifies.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-skip-faces
cases.purpose: Paragraphs wearing a skip face stay verbatim.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-org-inline-code-face-does-not-skip-paragraph
cases.purpose: An Org inline-code face must not make prose stay native-wrapped.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-org-block-face-stays-verbatim
cases.purpose: An Org block face still protects its own paragraph verbatim.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-inline-protection-has-no-single-cjk-lines
cases.purpose: A narrow public layout must not publish isolated CJK rows near inline code.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-skip-predicate
cases.purpose: The paragraph predicate is the general escape hatch.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-indent-roundtrip
cases.purpose: First-line indent spacers vanish exactly on unjustify.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-typed-char-inherits-no-marker
cases.purpose: Text typed beside a projection never inherits stale layout properties.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-save-writes-logical-text
cases.purpose: Saving a justified file buffer writes the logical text to disk, keeps the buffer justified, and leaves it unmodified.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-failed-save-preserves-layout
cases.purpose: A filesystem save failure must not leave the buffer unformatted.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-interrupted-save-preserves-layout
cases.purpose: A quit during writing must not leave the buffer unformatted.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-encoding-save-failure-is-retryable
cases.purpose: An encoding failure must preserve layout and allow a clean retry.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-justify-preserves-unmodified
cases.purpose: Pure re-layout must not flip `buffer-modified-p'.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-kill-ring-gets-logical-text
cases.purpose: Copying projected text strips EKP properties from logical characters.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-copy-filter-composes-and-restores
cases.purpose: EKP must preserve an existing buffer-local substring filter.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-kill-filter-composes-delete
cases.purpose: Composed filtering must preserve DELETE and prior-filter semantics.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-restores-inherited-copy-filter
cases.purpose: Final unjustify must reveal an inherited substring filter again.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-isearch-sees-logical-text
cases.purpose: Search sees logical text directly without suspending the projection.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-field-paragraph-skipped
cases.purpose: Paragraphs containing field or read-only text stay verbatim.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-read-only-command-barfs
cases.purpose: Interactive justify on a read-only buffer signals, not corrupts.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-no-break-public-commands
cases.purpose: Interactive no-break commands affect the public formatter and report scope.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-verbatim-public-commands
cases.purpose: Interactive verbatim commands protect the real region formatter.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-protection-workflows-discoverable
cases.purpose: Mode help and menu expose the existing protection workflows.

cases.name: ekp-buffer-test-justify-buffer-roundtrip
cases.purpose: ekp-justify-buffer / ekp-unjustify-buffer cover the whole buffer.

cases.name: ekp-c-test-module-build-rejects-unknown-profile
cases.purpose: Unknown build profiles fail before starting a process.

cases.name: ekp-test-hyphen-lang-fallback
cases.purpose: Short language codes resolve to a dictionary.

cases.name: ekp-test-hyphen-alternative-languages-fail-closed
cases.purpose: Replacement-pattern dictionaries must not degrade to plain Liang breaks. The golden forms are libhyphen outputs; EKP cannot safely emit them until its DP represents break-specific replacement widths.

cases.name: ekp-test-alignment-ragged-right
cases.purpose: Ragged-right: lines fit, interior spacing stays at ideal.

cases.name: ekp-test-alignment-ragged-left
cases.purpose: Ragged-left: every line is pushed flush to the right edge.

cases.name: ekp-test-alignment-center
cases.purpose: Center: leftover splits evenly between the two edges.

cases.name: ekp-test-first-line-indent
cases.purpose: First line carries an indent spacer; all lines fill the measure.

cases.name: ekp-test-parshape
cases.purpose: Per-line (INDENT . WIDTH) specs shape the paragraph.

cases.name: ekp-test-protrusion-hangs-line-end-punct
cases.purpose: Protrusion lets line-final fullwidth punctuation hang past the edge.

cases.name: ekp-test-protrusion-off-is-flush
cases.purpose: With protrusion off (default), no line exceeds the target width.

cases.name: ekp-test-no-break-span-atomic
cases.purpose: An ekp-no-break span never splits, stretches, or hyphenates.

cases.name: ekp-test-no-break-overlong-atom
cases.purpose: An atom wider than the line becomes a single emergency line.

cases.name: ekp-test-no-break-suppresses-hyphenation
cases.purpose: No soft hyphen appears inside a no-break span.

cases.name: ekp-test-nbsp-and-word-joiner
cases.purpose: NBSP and WORD JOINER keep their neighbors on the same line.

cases.name: ekp-test-kinsoku-rendered-output
cases.purpose: No rendered line starts with a closer or ends with an opener.

cases.name: ekp-test-break-policy-public-defaults
cases.purpose: The selected policy variables expose the approved public defaults.

cases.name: ekp-test-dp-cache-looseness-isolation
cases.purpose: Results cached at one looseness must not serve another. Regression: after justifying at looseness 0, changing `ekp-looseness' returned the stale looseness-0 layout for the same (string, width).

cases.name: ekp-test-style-change-invalidates-fast-path
cases.purpose: Changing a style variable must invalidate the same-string fast path. Regression: with the same string object, (setq ekp-alignment ...) kept returning the paragraph resolved under the previous style.
